project:
You’re out of labels!

It seems Anxi made you doubt and redo them too many times…
but that’s okay, you can always try again.

Time’s up!

You spent a bit too long adjusting things, but you can always try again, and this time, focus on what’s truly important.

You could still adjust it a little.
It’s almost perfect, wouldn’t that feel better?

You took a little extra time there!

5 seconds gone!

Don't forget what matters is that everything stays identified.

You lost 5 seconds fixing that label.

Remember, it doesn’t need to be perfect just clear enough to understand.

Well done!

That was brave, you chose to keep going and focus on what really matters.

Nice work!

You didn’t let doubt stop you.
Every step counts, even if it’s not perfect.

That took courage!

You continued with what’s important.
You’re doing great.

That label doesn’t look quite right.

Maybe people will think you weren’t careful enough.

Something feels off with that label.

Maybe you should fix it, just to make sure everything looks perfect?

Are you sure that one’s okay?

It doesn’t look quite right to me.

Are you really sure that label is fine?

Maybe you should check it again, just in case.

That label’s crooked.

What if someone sees it and thinks you didn’t try hard enough?

You could move it just a little bit more…

then it would be perfect, don’t you think?

It’s not properly placed.

Are you sure you want to leave it like that? People might think you don’t pay attention to details.

You did it!

that was so brave, everything’s labeled and ready. Now you can move on to what truly matters.
